exposure: fasting plasma glucose at 2 days postpartum
cohort: Participants were persons with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in their most recent pregnancy, defined by Carpenter-Coustan criteria.
finding: The developed predictive model, incorporating eight indicators, had a reasonable ability (AUC of 0.79) to predict impaired glucose tolerance at 1-year postpartum for individuals with recent GDM.
